provenance: Repository-authored synthetic C36 independent onboarding clone-to-value fixture; contains no real secret, key or credential material. Follows public guide docs/engineering/CLONE_TO_RUN.md with synthetic local identities matching ops/local/keycloak-realm.json.

steps.action: Authenticate synthetic owner alice@keyhelix.local via Keycloak OIDC
steps.expected_result: PKCE authorization code flow completes; scoped local session cookie is issued with vault-admin role

steps.action: Write secret metadata envelope into vault-prod
steps.expected_result: Secret metadata version 1 is written with fresh DEK and nonce sealed by OpenBao transit; no plaintext is persisted

steps.action: Perform fresh step-up reauthentication and reveal secret
steps.expected_result: Fresh reauthentication issues a step-up grant; OpenBao transit unwraps the DEK and plaintext is returned transiently with no-store cache

steps.action: Revoke access grants for member bob@keyhelix.local
steps.expected_result: Grant revocation is synchronous and durable; subsequent access attempts by bob are rejected with 403 access_denied

steps.action: Simulate key provider outage during reveal attempt
steps.expected_result: Key provider outage produces explicit HTTP 503 provider_unavailable; zero plaintext returned from memory or cache

steps.action: Restore isolated provider instance from recovery materials
steps.expected_result: OpenBao raft snapshot restore keeps sealed envelopes readable and revoked member grants remain revoked
